joan: Quick results from huntress13b quant runs. int8 gives big cost and throughput wins but we see instruction-following hits on multi-step tasks.
ravi: rough numbers please.
joan: p50 140ms -> 109ms, tokens/s +1.9x on H100, cost/1M $132 -> $95. Instr-adherence score down 2.8 pts on our coding+retrieval suite. human spot 300 samples: acceptables 88% -> 81%, hallucinations 3 -> 9.
sam: Product impact seems real. Can routing help?
joan: I prototyped score-gated hybrid routing: cheap confidence gate (embed sim + LM self-check) adds ~12ms and holds ~15% of traffic to fp16. That recovers ~85% of the fidelity loss in our sim.
priya: Unit econ?
joan: Assume 250k daily queries, avg 900 tokens. fp16 baseline ~$29.7k/day, full-int8 ~$21.4k/day, gate15% blended ~$24.8k/day (~16.5% savings vs fp16).
ravi: Ops: canary plan?
sam: Recommend staged rollout: 3% int8-only canary -> enable gating at 15% -> monitor hallucination and instr-adherence deltas -> ramp.
priya: For GTN we should call this "score-gated hybrid routing" and provide defaults: retrieval endpoints 15% fp16 gate, code-assist 40% fp16 conservative.
infra-bot: Canary task scheduled: sam will create huntress13b-int8-canary on 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z.
joan: Owners: joan -> int6 sweep (500 samples) and gate perf; sam -> canary + alerts; priya -> GTN blurb; ravi -> cost sims + significance. Will post artifacts when uploaded. :rocket:
